title: form view overlay: a section field the object does not have publishes valid, the record form draws an editable box for it, and what is typed there is dropped on save with a whole-record PATCH
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbX9avDwM2goWd7zimE

Filing gate: ① a product defect, found beside the clauses (records-forms.form-view-gallery), reach: `PUT /api/v1/meta/view` and the console record form, measured twice.
Business reason: a form view that names a field the object does not have (a typo, or a field deleted later) publishes as valid, and the record form then shows an editable box for it. A user types into it and saves; the value is silently thrown away, and the save becomes a PATCH of every field of the record, which can overwrite a field another person changed meanwhile. The lint's own message says such a field "is silently skipped and never renders on the form".
Reader who acts: the triage seat, then a `domain:ui` implementer in `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/sectionFields.ts`, and the `domain:server` lane if `FORM_FIELD_UNKNOWN` should reach the door's `_diagnostics`. QA suggestion only: `area:records`, p2.
Duplicate search: `fromObjectSchema` → 2 hits (#26452, #9019, both closed and unrelated); `form view unknown field section` → 331 hits, the top ones QA run records or unrelated.
Batch-of: release-18.3.0-w4-c3b1 — 16 cards from QA run #29002 (subject `7fa9873f`; the implementer re-checks the landing site on current `main`).

## Reproduction
1. As admin: `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.form?mode=draft` with `{name:'showcase_task.form', object:'showcase_task', viewKind:'form', isDefault:true, config:{type:'tabbed', data:{provider:'object',object:'showcase_task'}, sections:[{name:'overview',label:'Overview',columns:2,fields:['title','no_such_field']}, …]}}` → 200; `POST …/showcase_task.form/publish` → 200; the read serves `_diagnostics: {"valid":true}`.
2. Open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/record/ID/edit`: the Overview tab shows a text box labelled "no_such_field".
3. Type "ghost" in it and Save.

Expected: no control for an unknown field (and the lint's warning on the door). Actual: the box is drawn; Save sends a PATCH carrying the whole record (title, project, assignee, status, priority, estimate, dates, location, notes…) and no `no_such_field` key → 200, and "ghost" is gone with no error. A direct `PATCH {"no_such_field":"x"}` → 400 INVALID_FIELD. Reproduced 2 times on fresh loads.

## Mechanism (suspected)
`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/sectionFields.ts` `fromObjectSchema`: `if (!field) return { name, label: fieldName, type: 'input' }` disagrees with `packages/lint/src/validate-form-layout.ts` `FORM_FIELD_UNKNOWN` ("never renders").

QA-source: #29002 · records-forms.form-view-gallery · observed beside the clauses
